about: The emission cache and its executable entries: a module linked into its entry is held there until Release, a warm link of an unchanged module runs no link action, and the trim bounds the entries by age.

mutants.name: bins-relinked
mutants.rule: A warm link of an unchanged module with the same toolchain reuses its executable entry and runs no link action.

mutants.name: bins-unheld
mutants.rule: An executable entry is held, so no trim removes it, from before its link until Release, after the executable exits.

mutants.name: bins-variant-shared
mutants.rule: Two toolchains that differ in target, flags or tags link one module into two entries, so they never relink each other's executable.

mutants.name: bins-untrimmed
mutants.rule: The trim removes the executable entries no run used for unusedLimit, as it removes module entries.

mutants.name: results-unmarked
mutants.rule: A result hit marks its executable entry used, so a package whose runs only replay keeps its entry from the trim.
